name: AI Addendum
description: Common Paper AI Addendum: supplemental terms governing a provider's AI services, including inputs/outputs, usage restrictions and model training.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Business Associate Agreement (BAA) covering the handling of protected health information under HIPAA.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Cloud Service Agreement (CSA) for providing SaaS/cloud products to a customer.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Design Partner Agreement for early-stage products where a customer gives feedback in exchange for early access.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Common Paper Data Processing Agreement (DPA) governing the processing of personal data between a provider and a customer.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Common Paper Mutual NDA Standard Terms (v1.0) for two parties sharing confidential information.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement Cover Page
description: Cover Page for the Common Paper Mutual NDA, capturing the purpose, effective date, term and other deal-specific terms.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Partnership Agreement for business partnerships such as referral, reseller or co-marketing arrangements.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Pilot Agreement: a short-term agreement letting a prospective customer trial a product before a full commercial deal.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Professional Services Agreement (PSA) for services delivered under statements of work.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Common Paper Service Level Agreement (SLA) setting uptime targets, support response times and service credits.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Software License Agreement for licensing software to a customer.
